_comment: Claude Code hook configuration for the transboarded project root. Hook commands are anchored with ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} per Claude Code's hook-reliability guidance, so they resolve correctly even in worktree/subagent sessions where cwd can diverge from the project root.
_comment_permissions: Repository read, write, secret, and delivery policy comes only from validated .agentic/workflow.toml through the shared Python hooks. Claude host approvals remain independent external safety controls.
_comment_multiedit: MultiEdit is retained in the write matchers on purpose. Current Claude Code no longer emits it, so on an up-to-date host the alternation never fires and costs nothing; on an older host that still ships the tool, removing it would silently drop write-zone and secret-scan coverage for every batched edit. A matcher that is merely redundant is the safe side of that trade.
